exposure: Vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC) rates
outcome: Economic implications of reducing CS rates and improving VBAC rates
cohort: Annual cohort of women aged 18-44 years in Ireland and England/Wales
finding: Improvements in both nulliparous CS rates and VBAC rates lead to substantial long-term economic benefits, with reductions in CS rates among first-time mothers having a greater impact.
mod_finding: Reductions in CS rates among first-time mothers are associated with greater economic benefits compared to similar increases in VBAC rates.
